name: v56_pv13_cfo_capex_conversion
hypothesis: Companies whose expected operating cash flow covers capex better than product peers may reflect capital-efficient cash conversion distinct from plain FCF/EV.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfo_mean - capital_expenditure_amount) / enterprise_value, 126), pv13_di_6l) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capital_expenditure_amount / sales, 126), pv13_di_6l) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfo_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfo_low) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Uses pv13_di_6l and CFO/capex conversion rather than the v55 FCF/EV + EBITDA/EV pair; strict corr gate vs E5wRq3ZG and MPp7RPxn.

name: v56_pv13_cash_tax_interest_quality
hypothesis: Cash taxes paid can proxy durable taxable profitability, while low cash interest burden avoids levered value traps inside product groups.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(income_taxes_paid_total / enterprise_value, 126), pv13_rcsed_6l) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_interest_paid / enterprise_value, 126), pv13_rcsed_6l) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Avoids deferred-tax allowance/prepaid-tax active branch; tests realized cash tax and interest burden as a different accounting-quality route.

name: v56_stock_comp_burden_product_peer
hypothesis: Lower share-based compensation burden relative to product peers may indicate cleaner cash economics without using buyback, EPS, or close-open reversal.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), pv13_di_5l) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_compensation_cost_nonvested_awards / assets, 126), pv13_di_5l) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * share_award_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Revisits stock-compensation burden with product-peer ranking and no goodwill/tax/high-score stabilizer.

name: v56_credit_facility_unused_capacity
hypothesis: Low drawn credit-facility usage and available borrowing capacity may identify liquidity-flexible firms without relying on broad debt or net-debt fields.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * credit_facility_outstanding_amount / credit_facility_max_borrowing, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(credit_facility_remaining_capacity / credit_facility_max_borrowing, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: New credit-facility route, separate from debt maturity/lease/debt-issuance branches that previously weakened or correlated.

name: v56_analyst_total_assets_discipline
hypothesis: Lower expected asset base with tight analyst range may capture conservative investment discipline outside EPS growth and sales delivery.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totassets_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totassets_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totassets_low) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_totassets_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Non-EPS analyst balance-sheet surface; avoids sales actual surprise, EPSR, pretax visibility, and price-target/recommendation fields.

name: v56_analyst_shareholder_equity_cushion
hypothesis: A higher expected shareholder-equity cushion with narrow analyst disagreement may represent balance-sheet quality not identical to operating income or EPS yield.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_low) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Tests shareholder-equity forecast confidence rather than EPS, sales, FCF, or price-target analyst surfaces.

name: v56_sga_discipline_visibility
hypothesis: Lower expected SG&A intensity with tight analyst range may capture operating leverage and cost discipline distinct from raw profitability.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_mean / sales, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_low) / sales, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: A non-EPS, non-sales-delivery analyst cost surface; stop if it collapses into ordinary quality.

name: v56_pv13_cfo_forecast_confidence
hypothesis: Expected operating cash flow strength and narrow CFO estimate range may work better inside product peer groups than standard industry comparisons.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfo_mean / assets, 126), pv13_rcsed_6l) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfo_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfo_low) / assets, 126), pv13_rcsed_6l) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_cfo_number, 63), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: CFO forecast confidence, not FCF/EV valuation; watch corr vs E5wRq3ZG and cash-flow quality actives.

name: v56_dividend_guidance_confidence
hypothesis: High and narrow dividend guidance relative to price may capture defensive shareholder return without using buyback or share-count decline.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_guidances_basic_af_nd_div_minguidance / close, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_basic_af_nd_div_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_basic_af_nd_div_minguidance) / close, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Dividend guidance route avoids buyback authorization/reacquired-shares branches that previously hit payout correlation.

name: v56_cash_tax_minus_interest_spread
hypothesis: A high cash-tax-minus-interest spread relative to assets may represent realized profitability net of financing burden, with less direct overlap to ordinary FCF/EV.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank((income_taxes_paid_total - net_interest_paid) / assets, 126), pv13_di_6l) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_interest_paid / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: A compact cash-profitability minus financing-burden signal; separate from deferred-tax/prepaid-tax active alpha.
